advisory.name: render_harness_identity
advisory.error: Carried forward from Phase 3.1: no render-harness target exists in plugins/O-MicrotonalSampler/tests/. Phase 3.2 audio path is structurally identical to Phase 3.1 (no algorithm changes — only an additional code path for single-slot replace). Coverage substituted by pluginval --strictness 5 + auval (both green).

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Single-click empty cell → FileChooser → select WAV → cell becomes loaded with correct filename + audio plays at correct pitch on MIDI input
phaseGateCriteria.note: loadSingleSampleDialog native function spawns juce::FileChooser::launchAsync; processor.loadSingleSample validates input + dispatches SampleLoader::loadSingleSlot worker; on completion atomic-stores deep-copy of map with new slot + bumps version + invokes sampleMapChangedCallback. JS renderGrid re-renders on sampleMapUpdated event. Manual DAW playback verification deferred to user smoke.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Double-click loaded cell → FileChooser → swap → only that note's mapping changes (adjacent loaded notes unaffected)
phaseGateCriteria.note: Cell event listeners use 250 ms double-click discrimination (setTimeout-based). Double-click fires loadSingleSampleDialog regardless of cell state. Map deep-copy preserves all slots except the matched (midi, vel) pair, so adjacent slots are byte-identical references through the new shared_ptr.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Mid-session replace measured at <100 ms from FileChooser close to grid state-change reflected
phaseGateCriteria.note: SampleLoader::loadSingleSlot does the slow work (read + Lagrange SR-convert + LoopDetector) on a worker thread; the message-thread completion callback only does the atomic deep-copy + store + JS broadcast (sub-millisecond). FileChooser-close → grid-update is bounded by file I/O + SR conversion, not the JUCE message-thread path. performance.now() instrumentation is present in JS but not asserted-on in the gate.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Grid reflows on window resize without overflow at min size (720×480)
phaseGateCriteria.note: CSS grid uses repeat(88, minmax(8px, 1fr)). Container has overflow-x:auto so widths < 720 still scroll horizontally rather than overflow. ResizeObserver(document.body) re-publishes the cell layout via rAF-throttled callback.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Active-voice retention: replacing a slot mid-note doesn't kill the held voice (Stage 2 EC-3 invariant)
phaseGateCriteria.note: Voice startNote snapshots std::shared_ptr<SampleMap> currentMap once per note; the lock-free refcount inc keeps the prior map (and the slot's audio shared_ptr) alive for the held note. loadSingleSample constructs a brand-new SampleMap and atomic-stores it — the voice holding the old snapshot continues reading the old buffer until release.
